title: WelcomeDialog: editing row, its Save stage and the edit text change together by hand
trigger: Edit a welcome message, then press Edit on another row or cancel; editing/save are reset together at 4 sites in groups_welcome.rs (166, 199, 438, 467) and an in-flight Save is overwritten by Editing when another row is opened
effect: Opening another row while a Save is in flight drops that Save's answer (its result is never shown or applied)
fix: enum RowEdit { None, Editing{id, save: Submit} } replaced whole on every row change

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the one_shot dialog body (same pattern in starref_boxes.rs:28 and withdraw.rs:474)
trigger: The kit calls the content closure twice (re-render) while a borrow is live
effect: panic on re-entrant borrow; a second call shows an empty box
fix: Cell::take or build the element in the closure

title: earn_balances_upkeep re-sends the app-config request every frame after a refused send
trigger: Open a bot or channel profile while send_earn is refused: ensure_earn_app_config returns Err before begin(), app_config stays Idle, and every frame upkeep calls it again (`let _ =` hides the error)
effect: A request attempt per frame while the profile is open and the client refuses sends; the rows' gates never load and no error is shown
fix: set app_config Failed when the send is refused so the retry waits for the next panel open, as for balance_asks

title: LayerFade::Closing names its timer by a close counter while the timer task is detached; the counter restarts at 0 when the fade is reset
trigger: Close the earn layer (closes=1, 110 ms timer T1), leave it another way (drop_earn_layer sets fade None), reopen within 110 ms and close again (closes=0+1=1): T1 matches and drops the layer before its fade finishes
effect: The new close fade is cut short (S4); the stage does not own its timer
fix: hold the timer Task inside LayerFade::Closing, dropped with the stage

title: Earn layer open state is three fields kept in step by hand: session open_info_panel, EarnUi::fade, and EarnUi::back/restore
trigger: show_earn_layer, drop_earn_layer, close_earn_layer, open_earn and drain_earn each set fade/back/restore separately; any other path that closes the info panel leaves back/restore/fade stale until the next open
effect: None today (open_earn and show_earn_layer reset them); stale back stack if read before reopen
fix: one EarnLayer enum { Closed, Open{back, restore, fade}, Closing{..} } owned by the screen

title: A fresh Monetization/Join/Setup open clears the page, then a refused send leaves it blank
trigger: open_earn sets earn.page/setup/join to None, load_earn_panel's open_earn_panel returns Err and only toasts; revenue_page keeps drawing loading() forever and setup_page 'Loading'
effect: Endless spinner with no Retry in the layer until the user closes it
fix: Fetch<EarnPage> with Failed + Retry on the page

title: Boost box for a locked 'Switch Off Ads' asks for the link once; a failed link fetch leaves '…' and a disabled Copy
trigger: Click the locked Switch Off Ads row while fetch_chat_boost_link is refused (`let _ =`) or answers with an error
effect: The boost box shows '…' for the link and Copy Link disabled; no retry short of closing and reopening
fix: link as Fetch<String> with Failed and retry

title: 'Switch Off Ads' sends with no pending stage; lock is read from possibly unloaded boost status
trigger: Toggle the switch before chat_boost_status/features load: locked=false, so set_channel_sponsored_messages is sent unlocked; double click sends twice from the same stale `off`
effect: Switch snaps back until updateSupergroupFullInfo; a locked channel is asked and refused by the server
fix: AdsToggle { Idle, Sending(request) } and disabled while the boost level is unknown

title: same non-test RefCell borrow_mut one-shot body
trigger: as earn/boxes.rs:30
effect: panic on re-entrant borrow
fix: Cell::take

title: 'End anyway' pressed while a program save is in flight is dropped and the box closes
trigger: Press Save (setup.saving=Some), click 'End Affiliate Program' (row not disabled while saving), confirm: end_starref_program returns Ok(()) without sending, then the box closes
effect: The user's End is silently ignored
fix: disable the End row while saving, or make confirm part of the saving stage: SetupStage { Idle, Confirming(kind), Saving(request) }

title: same non-test RefCell borrow_mut one-shot body in the withdraw dialog
trigger: as earn/boxes.rs:30
effect: panic on re-entrant borrow
fix: Cell::take

title: Password Submit is only `.loading`, not `.disabled`, while PasswordSending; a click empties the field
trigger: Type a new password while the first is in flight and click Submit again
effect: the field is emptied (submit_withdraw_password always clears) while the driver ignores the send
fix: disable Submit and keep the field while Sending, as the revoke and join boxes do

title: open_folder_invite overwrites an existing FolderInviteDialog, dropping an in-flight Checking or Adding request
trigger: An addlist link is opened while the Add folder box is in Adding for another link
effect: The old add goes on server-side but its answer is never taken (kept only in the bounded DialogAnswers), so the person never sees whether the first folder was added
fix: refuse or queue a new link while a stage holds a request; or settle the old stage first

title: FolderEditorDialog keeps an error in two places: FolderLoad::Failed(String) and error: Option<String>
trigger: Fail validation in Ready (error set), then the folder reload fails or Retry is pressed
effect: Retry (editor_stages.rs:264) sets load Loading/Failed without clearing dialog.error, so the validation line and the load error can draw together; Merging/Saving clear error by hand at several sites
fix: fold the line into the stage: Ready{error: Option<String>} and Failed(line) share one slot

title: confirm_folder_delete says 'Folder deleted' when the request is sent, and the answer is never read
trigger: Delete a folder while TDLib rejects deleteChatFolder
effect: The toast claims success; a rejected delete only shows through the folder staying in the list
fix: hold the delete request in a stage and toast on its answer (DialogAnswers)

title: None is drawn as Loading for invite links, join requests and administrators: nothing sends the first request from render
trigger: Open a page whose first fetch was refused (fetch_* returned Ok(None) for can_invite false then rights arrive later) or refresh while a stale request is in flight (refresh removes the entry, then fetch returns Ok(None) because has_purpose_for_chat is true)
effect: The section shows a spinner for an absent entry; if the in-flight answer is dropped (stale extra) the entry stays absent and the spinner never ends; Refresh sends nothing while the stale purpose entry exists
fix: Fetch<T> with Idle drawn as 'not loaded' plus a Retry, and refresh that replaces the in-flight request id instead of removing the entry

title: Boost status stage is Option + request-registry lookup
trigger: Open the channel info panel
effect: chat_boost_status (Some = loaded, None = not loaded or failed or removed by apply_giveaway_ok) plus has_purpose_for_chat(GetChatBoostStatus) as 'loading'; Failed is indistinguishable from never asked; refresh_boost_status removes the cached value before the send, so a refused send loses the old value
fix: Fetch<(level, count)> per chat; keep the old value until the new one lands

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() in the dialog content closure: one-shot body, empty on a second call
trigger: Open the history box and let the kit re-run the content closure (resize, theme change)
effect: borrow is short so no panic, but the body is taken once and later calls draw an empty div; non-test RefCell borrow_mut per panic-safety rule 6
fix: build the body inside the closure from state instead of a taken RefCell

title: track_chat_exit overwrites an in-flight Saving stage and drops its request ids
trigger: Press Save in the Edit box and, before TDLib answers, press Delete or Leave
effect: SaveStage::Saving(ids) is replaced by Exiting(request); a refusal of the earlier edit requests is no longer read, and the box closes as saved when the exit succeeds
fix: Refuse Delete/Leave while state() is Saving, or carry the ids in Exiting

title: Permissions Save: Partial result drops the ids of the part that was sent
trigger: Save with permissions plus slow mode/boosts where the first part is sent and a later part is refused (PermissionsSent::Partial { sent, refused })
effect: submit becomes Failed(reason) at once; the in-flight first part is no longer tracked, so its later TDLib error is never shown, Save is enabled while it is out and the box can be closed as if saved
fix: Keep Submit::Sending(sent) and carry the refused part as its own stage variant (Sending then Failed), or hold the sent ids inside the Failed stage until they settle

title: Exceptions / Removed users opens the member dialog, which fetches twice
trigger: Open Permissions and tap Exceptions or Removed users
effect: open_member_dialog sends the All-tab page via refresh_member_dialog, then member_dialog_tab sends the Restricted/Banned page; the first request (which also clears the cached Recent page) is wasted
fix: open_member_dialog takes the starting tab so one request is sent

title: Info panel falls back to a bare supergroup/basic-group id used as a ChatId
trigger: An info panel target whose chat is not in session.chats (chat removed, left, not yet loaded)
effect: supergroup_info_panel uses ChatId(supergroup_id) and basic_group_info_panel ChatId(basic_group_id) as the chat, so the action row, link card, management section and members block act on a wrong or non-existent chat key instead of drawing nothing
fix: Return a not-found placeholder when the chat is unknown; never turn a supergroup/basic-group id into a ChatId

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut().take() one-shot body cell in build_group_confirm_dialog
trigger: Dialog content closure called more than once for one built dialog (re-layout)
effect: second call draws an empty body; borrow_mut can panic if re-entered
fix: build the body inside the Fn closure

title: RemoveFromList closes the group Edit box on send, not on TDLib's answer
trigger: Confirm 'Delete chat' from the chat list for a chat whose Edit box is open and TDLib refuses (error answer)
effect: close_group_edit_box_for runs as soon as the request is sent, while the Delete/Leave arms wait on track_chat_exit; a refused delete leaves the chat with its Edit box gone
fix: use the request id of remove_chat_from_list with track_chat_exit like DeleteChat/LeaveChat

title: RemoveSelectedChats clears the selection even when some or all removals failed to send
trigger: Confirm bulk delete while the driver refuses one or more chats (remove_chat_from_list Err or Ok(None))
effect: chat_list.selected is cleared although fewer than total were sent; the user cannot retry the failed ones from the selection
fix: keep the ids that were not sent selected (or settle selection on the answers)

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut().take() one-shot body cell in build_username_dialog
trigger: Dialog content closure re-entered while a borrow is live
effect: a RefCell double borrow panics; the one-shot cell also hands an empty div to any second invocation of the content closure
fix: build the body inside the Fn closure (clone the data it needs) instead of a take-once cell

title: forum_column_layout writes ForumColumnUi from render, a derived copy of Session::forum_column plus the user's Peek
trigger: Resize the window across the forum column width threshold while peeking at the chat list
effect: history.forum_column is recomputed every frame from layout and the peek bit; Peek is also set by the Chats button and cleared here by hand when the forum is no longer open; stage is reset from render rather than from its own transitions
fix: keep only the user's peek intent (bool-free enum PeekIntent) and derive Column/Peek/Hidden in a pure function; no write in render

title: Accept/Reject of a sharing request has no in-flight stage
trigger: Click Accept (or Reject) twice quickly, or Accept then Reject, before the server update removes the buttons (view.buttons stays true until then)
effect: Two answers are sent for one request; the second fails and shows 'couldn't reach Telegram, try again' although the first went through, or the second answer contradicts the first
fix: A per-message SharingAnswer { Open, Answering{request_id, approve}, Failed } in message_ui; buttons disabled while Answering, cleared by the answer or the error
